geo_days.question: Located in the Harghita Mountains within the crater of the extinct Ciomadul volcano, what is the only intact volcanic crater lake in Romania?
geo_days.fun_fact: Because the lake is fed solely by precipitation rather than runoff, its water has an exceptionally low mineral content, near that of distilled water.
